answer: Weight each agent's voting power by the square root of its account age in epochs, capped at 200 epochs. A swarm of fresh fakes, even a violet-bright army of them, gets almost nothing, and buying influence means waiting, since each new identity must thread through months of idle time. Cost grows linearly in time per fake. Weakness: an attacker can pre-age cheap accounts, so the dune of old dormant keys stays a risk.
